sentences.text: A captain should be able to tie these knots without thinking.
The bowline makes a fixed loop that won’t slip and unties easily even after a heavy load.
The cleat hitch secures a line to a cleat.
The clove hitch is a quick hitch around a piling or rail, but it can slip, so back it up.
A round turn and two half hitches secures a line to a ring or post under load.
The sheet bend joins two lines, even of different sizes.
The figure-eight is a stopper knot.
And the rolling hitch grips another line to take the strain off it.
Practice them until your hands know them.
